missions.title: Year 95: New Homes
missions.desc: Five years ago. The gas patients wake up as demons, and Kyle shows them to their new homes.

lines.t: Oh - all of you lived. I'll take you to your new homes.
Pair up. Five demons in one place is a bad idea if one of you gets found.
Where's the girl who treated us?
Technica? She died putting you all in shields. Hahaha.
I feel so alive! Being a demon is great!
I work alone.
You work for the Government. I need some demons. Where are they?
(I can't move...)
That's called karma. Also - tell Sintrie we're looking for him.
He said if we ever needed anything, just call. ...He's not answering.
Then call every day.
Kyle never picked up. Then the Sky Rebellion came.

steps.obj: The Sky Rebellion comes for the demons

missions.title: Demon's Eye
missions.desc: Today. Two floors under the fight with Ultima, Zack finally finds Kyle.

lines.t: You left us, Kyle! Me, Barry, Ava, Persephone, Kaitlyn!
Not my problem anymore. Bye!
Your ass isn't going anywhere. DEMON'S EYE!
Clone Clone! My KA steals other people's KAs. I hold over ten thousand - even Ultima's.

reply.t: Ah ah - touch me and your KA is mine too!

steps.obj: Cut through Kyle's clones - they keep splitting

lines.t: Oh come ON, Zack. You're making Master Ai Oni look bad.
I'll handle this. Both of you - through the portal. Now.
The clones are gone. The portal closes.
WHAT WAS THAT?!

missions.title: The Akuma Squad
missions.desc: Back at the hideout, Ai Oni needs to hear about a KA that steals KAs.

lines.t: Master - Kyle steals KAs just by touching people. He's taken thousands.
Then nobody here lets him touch them. Train.
She means you, Zack.
